name: Slots
checks: The RTP build each operator actually ships, volatility, max-win ceiling and how the mechanic pays.
measured: Published RTP; per-operator builds via RTP Watch

name: Game providers
checks: Whether the studio permits reduced RTP configurations, its volatility range, and catalogue reach.
measured: Configurations as published; in-client check via RTP Watch

name: Sportsbooks
checks: Whether the operator runs a sportsbook and esports book, who supplies it, cash-out and bet-builder options, and the payout caps in its betting rules.
measured: From each operator’s own pages; margin sampling pending

name: Prediction markets
checks: Cost to trade, book depth, resolution source, and what the payout rail actually requires.
measured: Fees as each venue publishes them

name: Wallets
checks: Custody model, chain coverage, what it shows you before you sign, and fee handling.
measured: Custody, protection, audits and swap fees from each wallet's own docs

name: Exchanges
checks: Entry fees, fiat rails, withdrawal limits, regulation and proof of reserves — and, once sampled, the spread you actually cross.
measured: Fees, rails and limits from each exchange's own pages; spread sampling pending
